reportedIssues: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is cut off mid-word under the third 'Fastest near you' card, making the name unreadable.
Under the third 'Fastest near you' card, the delivery fee text appears incomplete as '€1.90 deliverv' (or similarly truncated), so users cannot read the full fee information.
The pizza card shows a green badge reading '-100%', which looks broken or nonsensical as a discount (implying free or negative price) rather than a clear offer.
